dense_retrieval.title: Dense retrieval — brute-force cosine by default

inputs.text: the English retrieval query (chatqna sends the prefixed query text; the retriever receives the raw English text plus the pre-computed embedding)
inputs.embedding: query vector, 1024 dimensions, produced by the embedding service from the PREFIXED query

expected_output.search_call: asimilarity_search_with_relevance_scores(query, embedding, k, score_threshold, use_approx=False, filter_clause=<label clause or empty>)
expected_output.empty_result: a leg that returns nothing does not fail the request; the BM25 leg may still rescue the query (fusion runs before the empty check)

code: genie-ai-overlay/retriever/config.py:67-71 (distance strategy, use_approx, search mode, search start, graph, db)
notes: use_approx_search=false means an exact scan: the vector index dataprep builds is NOT consulted on the query path.
RETRIEVER_ARANGO_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD is forwarded by chatqna but never read by the retriever — it has no effect on the deployed stack.
fetch_k is only consulted by the mmr branch, which the deployed search mode never selects.

bm25_lexical_leg.title: BM25 leg — ArangoSearch analyzer view, native BM25

inputs.text: the RAW English query (never the prefixed one): TOKENS(@query, @analyzer)

expected_output.view: GRAPH_BM25_VIEW (arangosearch view over GRAPH_SOURCE, created at runtime by the retriever)
expected_output.view_creation: on boot for the default graph, and lazily per graph on first BM25 use; a failure is logged and never raised
expected_output.aql: FOR doc IN `GRAPH_BM25_VIEW` SEARCH ANALYZER(doc.text IN TOKENS(@query, @analyzer), @analyzer) <label clause> LET _bm25_score = BM25(doc) SORT _bm25_score DESC LIMIT @n RETURN {key, text, chunk_labels, score}
expected_output.failure: any error is logged (BM25 search failed on view ...) and the leg returns []

rrf_fusion.title: RRF fusion of the dense and lexical legs

expected_output.formula: score(doc) += weight / (rrf_k + rank), rank counted per channel over newly seen ids only
expected_output.identity: the chunk _key (COLLECTION/ prefix stripped); a document without a key is kept standalone
expected_output.ordering: descending fused score; ties keep insertion order, which favours the dense channel
expected_output.truncation: the fused list is truncated to RETRIEVER_ARANGO_K (20) after fusion
expected_output.failure: a fusion error logs (Hybrid BM25+RRF fusion failed, falling back to dense-only) and the dense-only list is used

inputs.labels: the requested labels, encoded in the search_start carrier or built from the request context

expected_output.aql_or: FILTER (doc.chunk_labels != null) AND (["L1","L2"] ANY IN doc.chunk_labels)
expected_output.aql_and: FILTER (doc.chunk_labels != null) AND (["L1","L2"] ALL IN doc.chunk_labels)
expected_output.no_labels: no filter clause is emitted at all

defense_in_depth_post_filter.title: Defense-in-depth post-filter (label re-check in Python)

inputs.results: the dense leg results and each BM25 row

expected_output.dense_leg: every result whose chunk_labels do not satisfy the strategy is dropped, after the database-side filter
expected_output.bm25_leg: every row whose chunk_labels do not satisfy the strategy is skipped
expected_output.chunk_without_labels: dropped whenever a label filter is active

defense_in_depth_post_filter.note: There is no score-threshold post-filter in the retriever: the score threshold is applied inside the similarity search call.

expected_output.aql: ONE batched AQL for all chunks: FOR doc IN `GRAPH_SOURCE` FILTER doc._key IN @chunk_ids RETURN {key: doc._key, file_id: doc.file_id}
expected_output.metadata: metadata.file_ids is a LIST: [file_id] when the chunk carries one, [] when it does not
expected_output.absent: an absent file_id yields [], never null and never a missing key

cap1_identity_join.title: CAP-1 identity join (repo_id + bundle_version), tolerated absence

expected_output.aql: FOR doc IN `GRAPH_SOURCE` FILTER doc._key IN @chunk_ids LET meta = FIRST(FOR m IN okf_concepts_meta FILTER m.graph_name == @graph_name AND m.concept_id == doc.file_id RETURN m) RETURN {key: doc._key, repo_id: meta.repo_id, bundle_version: meta.bundle_version}
expected_output.identity_document_absent: the two keys are NOT set — the chunk is served unattributed, with no warning
expected_output.join_failure: the whole enrichment is skipped, an ERROR is logged (OKF identity enrichment failed (chunk identity left as-is): ...) and the leg is not broken

inputs.results: the enriched results of a leg

expected_output.graph_name: always set to the leg's graph name
expected_output.repo_id: set only when the caller passes one (never in the legacy single-graph path)

inputs.carrier: the encoded graph names carried in the request

expected_output.engagement: only when the carrier names at least one graph; an empty carrier keeps the legacy single-graph path
expected_output.leg_failure: a timed-out or failed leg is a ZERO-HIT leg — the fusion continues with the surviving legs
expected_output.cross_graph_fusion: second-level RRF over the legs, keyed on (graph_name, chunk_id), unweighted (1/(rrf_k + rank)), truncated to min(k, candidate cap global)

routing.title: Graph routing gate (head selection, forbidden tags, chunk competition)

inputs.query_embedding: the query vector (routing is skipped without one)

expected_output.skipped: routing is skipped (and the full carrier is fanned out) when it is disabled, when there is no query embedding, or when fewer than two OKF graphs are on the carrier
expected_output.gate_order: FLOOR (score < head floor) -> VETO (a forbidden per-tag vector at cosine >= forbidden tag max) -> MARGIN (score - forbidden centroid cosine <= head margin); a head passes only if every applicable gate passes
expected_output.heads_supersede: when any head passes, ONLY the claimed graphs are searched and the chunk probe is skipped entirely
expected_output.chunk_competition: per-graph probe, a graph qualifies with >= min_chunks hits, and the best-count graph qualifies even when none reaches the minimum
expected_output.degraded: a failed probe degrades to searching ALL carrier graphs (ROUTING DEGRADED ...)

expected_output.resolved_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
expected_output.resolution_order: deployer overrides first (first match wins), then the built-in table (first match wins, most specific first)
expected_output.no_prefix_models: a model with no entry (BAAI/bge-m3, sentence-transformers/*, mxbai-embed-large, ...) gets NO prefix — the query is embedded raw

reranking_evidence_selection.title: TEI reranking + evidence selection

inputs.docs: the retrieved documents, in retrieval order

expected_output.invocation: chatqna -> POST {RERANK_SERVER_HOST_IP}:{RERANK_SERVER_PORT}/v1/reranking, which calls TEI POST {base_url}/rerank with {"query": ..., "texts": [...], "truncate": false}; no top_n is sent to TEI, no Authorization header is sent
expected_output.strategy_slice: keep the first RERANKER_TOP_N entries of the score-descending response
expected_output.strategy_threshold: keep every doc with score >= RERANKING_THRESHOLD (count not capped by top_n)
expected_output.strategy_slice_threshold: keep docs with score >= RERANKING_THRESHOLD, capped at RERANKER_TOP_N
expected_output.strategy_knee_threshold: keep the knee+1 leading entries of the score curve; RERANKING_THRESHOLD is NOT consulted by this branch
expected_output.strategy_adaptive: keep every candidate whose value is strictly greater than the minimum value threshold; RERANKER_TOP_N does NOT cap it; it hard-fails when the chunk embeddings are missing or misaligned
expected_output.order: the selected passages keep the reranker's score-descending order all the way into the prompt and into source_documents
expected_output.calibration: none -> the raw TEI score is used; sigmoid -> 1/(1+exp(-score/temperature)), applied at confidence time only, never to the selection comparisons
expected_output.empty_selection: the LLM receives the abstention instructions instead of documents: abstained=true, abstention_reason=reranker_selected_nothing

code: genie-ai-overlay/chatqna/genieai_chatqna.py:4936-4944 (chatqna sends strategy, top_n and threshold explicitly)
genie-ai-overlay/chatqna/genieai_chatqna.py:3057-3066, :3121-3123 (the order is preserved into the prompt)
reranking_evidence_selection.note: Because chatqna always sends the strategy, top_n and the threshold, the reranker container's own defaults are inert on the chat path.

reranker_down.title: Reranker-down behavior — one behavior per failure mode

expected_output.unreachable_or_timeout: the error propagates: no evidence, the turn fails (503 llm_unavailable for a model-discovery/transport error, otherwise 500). There is NO fallback to the retrieval order.
expected_output.http_422_input_too_long: HTTP 200 with abstained=true, abstention_reason=reranker_input_too_long, and an English abstention text
expected_output.score_count_mismatch: not fatal: a warning is logged and the selection proceeds
expected_output.index_out_of_range: not fatal: the document is skipped
expected_output.opaque_500_seen_as_an_empty_result: the LLM receives the abstention instructions: abstained=true, abstention_reason=reranker_selected_nothing

preparation.title: Input preparation pipeline — language detection, translation to English, bounds, status
order: the caller names a language, or none is named
when none is named (or the named code was refused), the LAST USER MESSAGE is language-detected
the detected code is validated against the language registry; an unsupported code falls back to EN
when the history language is not EN, the history is translated to English
the last USER segment of the translated history becomes the retrieval query
the query instruction prefix is applied and the query is embedded
query_translation_status is stamped on the orchestrate span and in the response metadata
code: genie-ai-overlay/chatqna/genieai_chatqna.py:1321-1322 (the char budget and the USER marker pattern)

status_values.translated: the history was translated to English
status_values.passthrough_english: the history was already English and English was established
status_values.passthrough_unknown_language: no language was named and none could be established
status_values.fallback_timeout: the translator timed out — the SOURCE-language history is embedded
status_values.fallback_error: the translation failed for any other reason (blank input, blank completion, unreadable registry, unknown model failure) — the SOURCE-language history is embedded

bounds.MAX_TRANSLATION_CHARS: unset -> derived from the serving window, capped by the code default of 2000 characters
bounds.multi_message_history: the oldest turns are dropped and the newest message's tail is truncated to the budget — the turn is NOT refused
bounds.generation_time_truncation: when the prompt exceeds the model window, the OLDEST history segments are dropped; the retrieved documents are never truncated

failure_classes.trigger: the translation endpoint is unreachable, errors, or times out
failure_classes.expected_outcome: the turn still answers; the SOURCE-language history is embedded (degraded retrieval) and the status is fallback_timeout (timeout) or fallback_error (other failure). The status makes the degradation visible.

failure_classes.trigger: the query does not fit the translation window (TranslationInputTooLongError)
failure_classes.expected_outcome: the turn is REFUSED: HTTP 422 with body {"detail": {"error": "translation_input_too_long", "message": ..., "abstained": true, "abstention_reason": "translation_input_too_long"}}. There is NO untranslated fallback.

failure_classes.trigger: the translation model answers 200 with an empty completion
failure_classes.expected_outcome: the turn still answers; the SOURCE-language history is embedded and the status is fallback_error. A blank translation is a failure, never a silent success.

known_gaps: The venue corpus holds 3 chunks, so result-LEVEL fixtures (which documents come back for a given query) are not stable and are not recorded. The contract records the BEHAVIOR (order, shape, statuses, enrichment), not a corpus snapshot.
langdetect is used without a fixed DetectorFactory seed, so the detected code for a short sample is not deterministic across runs; the recorded locales were verified on the running stack.
The chart does not template the RETRIEVER_HYBRID_* knobs for the chatqna container; only the retriever container carries them.
